notes.title: Threat Shield 1.1.0: GeoIP country blocking and DNS redirection rules are now loaded into the firewall (known issue of 1.1.0)

Threat Shield 1.1.0: inbound protection with DNSBL reputation checks and flood limits for exposed services
Threat Shield 1.1.0: live threat map with a full-screen view in three styles and a dashboard widget
Threat Shield 1.1.0: health checks with one-click fixes and a one-switch setup
